title: LegalScore: Development of a Benchmark for Evaluating AI Models in Legal Career Exams in Brazil
benchmark_measurement: This benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured the performance of AI models on legal career exams in Brazil.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the performance of AI models in Brazilian legal examinations.
